companies.description: Customer company: the tenant that owns branches, memberships, content, devices and publications.
companies.lifecycle: Created ACTIVE by its first responsible administrator; suspension is a state. No runtime deletion; erasure and retention follow PH-13.

id.description: Backend-generated immutable company UUID; the tenant identifier and public resource ID.

display_name.description: Company name shown to its members.

status.description: ACTIVE companies allow protected operations; SUSPENDED denies them to members.

default_locale.description: Default interface locale for the company: pt-BR or en-US.

time_zone.description: Default IANA time zone for new branches; business time never uses the host time zone.

version.description: Optimistic concurrency token incremented once per successful settings change.

created_by_principal_id.description: Principal who created the company and became its first responsible administrator.

creation_key.description: Creator-supplied idempotency key, unique per creator, that makes company creation safely repeatable.

creation_fingerprint.description: Immutable SHA-256 fingerprint of the normalized original creation inputs; retries compare it rather than mutable company settings. Not exposed in the API.

updated_at.description: PostgreSQL-clock instant of the latest settings change; not audit history.

objects.companies_created_by_principal_id_fkey: The creator is an existing principal.
objects.companies_creator_key_unique: One company per creator and creation key, including racing retries.
objects.companies_time_zone_nonblank: Time zone has the IANA identifier shape; the API validates it against the runtime's zone database.
objects.companies_creation_key_format: Creation keys use the documented opaque ASCII alphabet.
objects.companies_creation_fingerprint_format: Creation fingerprints are lowercase SHA-256 hex values.

branches.description: Branch of a company: a location with its own business time zone, assigned members and, later, devices.
branches.lifecycle: Created ACTIVE; archived rather than deleted so references remain valid.

id.description: Backend-generated immutable branch UUID; public resource ID.

name.description: Branch name, unique among the company's active branches regardless of case.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone for the branch's local business time.

status.description: ACTIVE branches are usable; ARCHIVED branches are retained for references.

version.description: Optimistic concurrency token incremented once per successful change.

updated_at.description: PostgreSQL-clock instant of the latest change; not audit history.

objects.branches_company_id_fkey: A branch belongs to an existing company.
objects.branches_company_id_id_key: Tenant key that tenant references target.
objects.branches_company_status_name_idx: Supports listing a company's branches by state and name.
objects.branches_company_active_name_unique: Active branch names are unique within a company, ignoring case, including racing creations.
objects.branches_time_zone_nonblank: Time zone has the IANA identifier shape.

memberships.description: A principal's membership in one company; access comes only from its unexpired grants.
memberships.lifecycle: Created ACTIVE; company administrators may suspend, reactivate or terminally remove membership with an observed version. Responsibility and the last active administrator are protected. Historical attribution is retained; no runtime deletion.

company_id.description: Company of the membership; immutable (tenant key).

principal_id.description: Member principal; a principal may hold memberships in several companies that never see each other.

version.description: Optimistic concurrency token for membership changes.

updated_at.description: PostgreSQL-clock instant of the latest change.

objects.memberships_company_id_fkey: A membership belongs to an existing company.
objects.memberships_principal_id_fkey: The member is an existing principal.
objects.memberships_company_id_id_key: Tenant key that tenant references target.
objects.memberships_company_principal_current_ke: At most one current (not REMOVED) membership per principal and company; a removed membership stays as history and the person can return through a new membership.

company_responsibilities.description: The company's designated responsible administrator, who approves additional administrators (P10).
company_responsibilities.lifecycle: Created with the company; moves to another active administrator only when that successor accepts a pending responsibility transfer.

company_id.description: Company whose responsibility this row records; one row per company.

membership_id.description: Membership of the responsible administrator in the same company.

objects.company_responsibilities_pkey: Exactly one responsible administrator per company.
objects.company_responsibilities_company_id_fkey: Responsibility belongs to an existing company.
objects.company_responsibilities_company_id_memb: The responsible membership belongs to the same company.
objects.company_responsibilities_membership_key: Supports the composite reference to the responsible membership.

membership_grants.description: A standard role granted to a membership over the whole company or explicit branches; grants combine additively.
membership_grants.lifecycle: Effective from starts_at until expires_at or revoked_at; company administrators revoke grants, never delete them, and expired or revoked grants are retained for attribution.

company_id.description: Company of the grant; immutable (tenant key).

role.description: Standard role preset: COMPANY_ADMINISTRATOR, BRANCH_MANAGER or OPERATOR; capabilities are defined by the application.

scope.description: COMPANY covers every branch, including future ones; BRANCHES covers only the listed branches.

expires_at.description: Instant a temporary grant stops being effective; no automatic renewal.

granted_by_membership_id.description: Membership that granted it, for attribution.

revoked_at.description: Instant a company administrator revoked the grant; revocation is terminal.
revoked_at.nullMeaning: The grant has not been revoked.

objects.membership_grants_company_id_fkey: A grant belongs to an existing company.
objects.membership_grants_company_id_membership_: The holder is a membership of the same company.
objects.membership_grants_company_id_granted_by_: The grantor, when present, is a membership of the same company.
objects.membership_grants_company_id_id_key: Tenant key that branch scopes target.
objects.membership_grants_expiry_after_start: A temporary grant expires after it starts.

membership_grant_branches.description: Explicit branches covered by a BRANCHES-scoped grant; new branches never join silently.
membership_grant_branches.lifecycle: Written with the grant; retained while the grant exists.

company_id.description: Company shared by the grant and the branch.

grant_id.description: Grant whose scope includes the branch.

objects.membership_grant_branches_pkey: A branch appears at most once in a grant's scope.
objects.membership_grant_branches_company_id_fke: The scope belongs to an existing company.
objects.membership_grant_branches_company_id_gra: The grant belongs to the same company.
objects.membership_grant_branches_company_id_bra: The branch belongs to the same company; mixed-company scopes are unrepresentable.
objects.membership_grant_branches_branch_idx: Supports finding the grants that cover a branch.

organization_audit_events.description: Append-only attributable record of company, branch, membership and grant changes, written in the same transaction as each change.
organization_audit_events.lifecycle: Never updated or deleted by the runtime; retention follows PH-13.

company_id.description: Company whose change the event records.

actor_membership_id.nullMeaning: The actor had no membership yet, as when creating the company.

action.description: Stable dotted action identifier, such as company.created or branch.archived.

target_type.description: Kind of changed resource, such as company or branch.

details.description: Allowlisted non-secret change details: changed field names and, for branch events, the branch name at the time of the event. Never secrets or full payloads.

objects.organization_audit_events_company_id_fke: An event belongs to an existing company.
objects.organization_audit_events_actor_principa: The actor is an existing principal.
objects.organization_audit_events_company_id_act: The actor membership, when present, belongs to the same company.
objects.organization_audit_events_company_id_id_: Tenant key for future references to events.
objects.organization_audit_events_action_format: Actions use the stable dotted identifier format.
objects.organization_audit_events_details_object: Details are always a JSON object.

organization_audit_event_branches.description: Branches an organization audit event concerns; branch managers read only events whose branches all lie within their own branches.
organization_audit_event_branches.lifecycle: Written with the event; never updated or deleted by the runtime. An event without rows is a company-level operation.

company_id.description: Company shared by the event and the branch.

event_id.description: Audit event that concerns the branch.

objects.organization_audit_event_branches_pkey: A branch appears at most once per event.
objects.organization_audit_event_branches_compan: The row belongs to an existing company.
The event belongs to the same company.
The branch belongs to the same company; mixed-company audit scopes are unrepresentable.
objects.organization_audit_event_branches_branch: Supports finding the events that concern a branch.

responsibility_transfers.description: A responsible administrator's proposal to hand company responsibility to another active administrator; it takes effect only when that successor accepts.
responsibility_transfers.lifecycle: Created PENDING; becomes ACCEPTED, DECLINED by the successor, CANCELLED by the proposer, or EXPIRED after seven days. Retained for attribution; no runtime deletion.

company_id.description: Company whose responsibility would move; immutable (tenant key).

from_membership_id.description: Membership of the responsible administrator who proposed the transfer.

to_membership_id.description: Membership of the proposed successor, who must still be an active company administrator when accepting.

status.description: PENDING until the successor accepts or declines, the proposer cancels, or the proposal expires.

expires_at.description: Instant after which the pending proposal can no longer be accepted.

decided_at.description: PostgreSQL-clock instant the proposal stopped being pending.

objects.responsibility_transfers_company_id_fkey: A transfer belongs to an existing company.
objects.responsibility_transfers_company_id_from: The proposer is a membership of the same company.
objects.responsibility_transfers_company_id_to_m: The successor is a membership of the same company.
objects.responsibility_transfers_company_id_id_k: Tenant key for future references to transfers.
objects.responsibility_transfers_successor_idx: Supports finding the proposals addressed to a successor.
objects.responsibility_transfers_one_pending: At most one pending transfer per company, including racing proposals.
objects.responsibility_transfers_distinct_partie: A responsible administrator cannot propose themselves.
objects.responsibility_transfers_expiry_after_cr: A proposal expires after it was made.
objects.responsibility_transfers_decision_state: A decision instant exists exactly for proposals that are no longer pending.

company_invitations.description: An invitation for a recipient address to join a company with one grant; only the person signed in with that verified address can accept it.
company_invitations.lifecycle: Created PENDING with a seven-day validity; becomes ACCEPTED, REVOKED by an inviter, REPLACED by a resend or EXPIRED. The recipient address is replaced by a tombstone (NULL) 90 days after the invitation becomes final (provisional until PH-13); the row and its audit events remain.

company_id.description: Company the invitation admits to; immutable (tenant key).

recipient_email.description: Trimmed, lower-cased recipient address the accepting identity's verified email must equal.
recipient_email.nullMeaning: The invitation is final and its retention period ended, so the address was erased.

credential_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the invitation's 256-bit credential; the credential itself is never stored in plaintext.

role.description: Standard role the accepted invitation grants.

scope.description: COMPANY or explicit BRANCHES listed in company_invitation_branches; administration is always company-wide.

grant_expires_at.description: Expiry of the granted access once accepted; never renewed automatically (P30).
grant_expires_at.nullMeaning: The granted access does not expire.

invited_by_membership_id.description: Membership of the inviter, whose authority is rechecked at acceptance.

status.description: PENDING until accepted, revoked, replaced or expired.

message_id.description: Outbound email that carries the invitation, owned by the mail module; a soft reference, because the mail module deletes final messages after their retention period.

replaces_invitation_id.description: Pending invitation this one replaced through a resend.
replaces_invitation_id.nullMeaning: The invitation was not created by a resend.

accepted_membership_id.description: Membership that received the invited grant on acceptance.

created_at.description: PostgreSQL-clock instant the invitation was created.

expires_at.description: Instant after which the pending invitation can no longer be accepted.

decided_at.description: PostgreSQL-clock instant the invitation stopped being pending.

objects.company_invitations_company_id_fkey: An invitation belongs to an existing company.
objects.company_invitations_company_id_invited_b: The inviter is a membership of the same company.
objects.company_invitations_company_id_accepted_: The accepting membership belongs to the same company.
objects.company_invitations_company_id_replaces_: A resend replaces an invitation of the same company.
objects.company_invitations_company_id_id_key: Tenant key for references to invitations.
objects.company_invitations_credential_key: Finds an invitation by credential hash; credentials never collide.
objects.company_invitations_company_time_idx: Lists a company's invitations newest first with stable keyset pagination.
objects.company_invitations_recipient_idx: Counts recent invitations to one address across companies for the abuse limit.
objects.company_invitations_one_pending: At most one pending invitation per company and address, including racing requests.
objects.company_invitations_credential_hash_leng: The stored credential hash is a SHA-256 digest.
objects.company_invitations_recipient_normalized: Recipient addresses are stored trimmed and lower-cased.
objects.company_invitations_pending_recipient: A pending invitation always has its recipient address.
objects.company_invitations_expiry_after_creatio: An invitation expires after it was created.
objects.company_invitations_grant_expiry_after_c: A temporary grant ends after the invitation was created.
objects.company_invitations_decision_state: A decision instant exists exactly for invitations that are no longer pending.
objects.company_invitations_acceptance_state: Exactly the accepted invitations name the membership that received the grant.

company_invitation_branches.description: Explicit branches of a branch-scoped invitation; all must still be active when it is accepted.
company_invitation_branches.lifecycle: Created with its invitation and never changed.

branch_id.description: A branch the accepted grant will cover.

objects.company_invitation_branches_pkey: Each branch appears once per invitation.
objects.company_invitation_branches_company_id_f: Rows belong to an existing company.
objects.company_invitation_branches_company_id_i: The invitation belongs to the same company.
objects.company_invitation_branches_company_id_b: The branch belongs to the same company.
objects.company_invitation_branches_branch_idx: Finds invitations that name a branch.

enums.MembershipStatus: Membership state: ACTIVE, SUSPENDED or REMOVED.
enums.AccessRole: Standard role presets: COMPANY_ADMINISTRATOR, BRANCH_MANAGER and OPERATOR.
enums.GrantScope: Grant scope: COMPANY or explicit BRANCHES.
enums.ResponsibilityTransferStatus: Responsibility transfer state: PENDING, ACCEPTED, DECLINED, CANCELLED or EXPIRED.
enums.InvitationStatus: Invitation state: PENDING, ACCEPTED, REVOKED, REPLACED or EXPIRED.
